facts.fact: Senegal's CDP said on 5 November 2026 that recording or reproducing a person's voice or image by AI without legal basis is unlawful processing under Law 2008-12.

SEN.note: The document states no government use of AI.
The document states no AI tool in a public sector system.
The document states no AI built or hosted in Senegal.

facts.fact: The CDP issued a public communique on 5 November 2026 on AI voice-cloning scams and receives complaints from people whose voice or image was used irregularly.

systems.system: Commission de Protection des Donnees Personnelles (CDP)

facts.fact: The CDP cited Law no. 2008-12 of 25 January 2008 on personal data protection as the law under which voice and image are personal data.
The CDP acted as the supervisory body by issuing a public communique and a complaints channel on 5 November 2026.
The CDP issued a public warning on AI voice-cloning and deepfake scams, with no decision on any organisation.
